label: narrative event clause boundary
explanation: It fires contextually in English narrative/event-report clauses, on punctuation and connective function words that mark clause boundaries or introduce event participants (commas, quotes, of, by, to, with, and). It is strongest when the token is a salient event marker—e.g., story of, brought by, happen to, or an event verb—and weak or silent on non-event content and incidental function words.
